verdict.rationale: Proton Pass is a SaaS password manager, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents only a CLI and data export formats (PGP-encrypted JSON, CSV), and the llms.txt and docs-md probes returned 404. Nothing in the pack shows a published OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The CLI and export features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
